display.purpose: Page and card headings, course titles. JetBrains Mono, the student's own working face.

body.purpose: Running copy, lede text, empty-state messages. System sans, restrained.

control.purpose: The wordmark and anything a person directly operates — primary button, ruled input fields, the search field. Sits under Body so form chrome reads tightened, not blocky.

meta.purpose: Secondary sentence-length text that isn't a label — error messages, the signed-in 'who' row, course meta line. Between Label and Body.

label.purpose: Course codes, tab text, back-link, secondary buttons, list-row credits/meta, loading indicator — the handwritten margin-label register.

field-label.purpose: Form field labels specifically — the smallest step in the Label register.

shadows.name: tab-rest
shadows.purpose: Shallow lift for an unselected index-divider tab; not used elsewhere.

shadows.name: tab-selected
shadows.purpose: Deeper lift when a tab is selected and moves flush.

motion.name: ease-mark
motion.purpose: Primary button's highlighter-mark clip-path and lift transition.

motion.name: ease-tab
motion.purpose: Tab top-offset and shadow transition between rest and selected.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width action button whose only surface is a highlighter-mark stroke behind bold ink text — never a filled box.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; border: none; background: transparent; color: #1a1d0f; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; isolation: isolate; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 6%; right: 6%; bottom: 14%; height: 72%; background: #bfd730; clip-path: polygon(1% 10%, 99% 3%, 100% 90%, 2% 97%); z-index: -1; transition: clip-path 0.15s ease-out, transform 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover::before, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible::before { clip-path: polygon(0.5% 5%, 99% 9%, 99.5% 95%, 1% 91%); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active::before { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.55; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis outlined action, e.g. 'Use a different email' or '+ Add exam intel'.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { padding: 8px 12px; border: 1.5px solid #b9c2d0; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: #5b6169; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { border-color: #6b7519; color: #24272b; }

components.name: Ruled Input Field
components.description: Underline-only text field; the ruled-paper metaphor applied to form controls. Selects and textareas share the same rule.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-field label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: #5b6169; } .ds-field input { padding: 8px 4px; border: none; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #b9c2d0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #24272b; font: inherit; font-size: 16px; width: 100%; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #5b6169; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-bottom-color: #6b7519; box-shadow: 0 1.5px 0 0 #6b7519; }

components.name: Index Tab
components.description: Physical index-divider tab; selected state fills with the highlighter mark and moves flush, the one place the mark fills a full surface.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-tab { padding: 8px 16px; background: #fbfbf9; border: 1px solid #b9c2d0; border-radius: 3px; color: #5b6169; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; position: relative; top: 4px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(36, 39, 43, 0.08); transition: top 0.12s ease-out, box-shadow 0.12s ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true'] { background: #bfd730; border-color: #bfd730; color: #1a1d0f; top: 0; box-shadow: 0 3px 6px rgba(36, 39, 43, 0.18); }

components.name: Course Row
components.description: Signature list unit: baseline-aligned mono code, title, tabular meta, hairline bottom rule, highlighter-tinted hover wash.
components.html: ITS301Software Engineering3 cr
components.css: .ds-course-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 8px; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; border-bottom: 1px solid #d8dee8; } .ds-course-row:hover, .ds-course-row:focus-visible { background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(191, 215, 48, 0.2), rgba(191, 215, 48, 0) 70%); } .ds-code { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-weight: 700; color: #24272b; white-space: nowrap; min-width: 4.5em; } .ds-title { flex: 1; color: #24272b; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-credits { font-size: 13px; color: #5b6169; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Empty State
components.description: Honest-emptiness pattern (PRODUCT.md): a dashed perforation rule and plain-language copy inviting contribution, never an illustration or fake activity.
components.html: No exam intel yet for DES221. Be the first to report the format, coverage, and difficulty.
components.css: .ds-empty-state { border-top: 1px dashed #b9c2d0; padding: 32px 0; text-align: left; } .ds-empty-state p { margin: 0; max-width: 46ch; color: #5b6169; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; }

components.name: Support Banner
components.description: Mock donation ask at the foot of the course list — a dashed top rule, restrained copy, and suggested-amount buttons in the secondary-button register. No real payment processing.
components.html: SIIT Study Hub is free and stays that way. If it's saved you time, consider chipping in.
components.css: .ds-support-banner { margin-top: 32px; padding-top: 24px; border-top: 1px dashed #b9c2d0; } .ds-support-banner p { max-width: 52ch; margin: 0 0 12px; color: #5b6169; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; } .ds-support-amounts { display: flex; gap: 8px; }

narrative.overview:
SIIT Study Hub reads as the lab notebook a Digital Engineering student already keeps, not a rounded EdTech dashboard. It refuses Google Classroom's soft cards-on-gray in favor of ruled structure, graphite ink, and a single highlighter accent used the way a student actually highlights: to mark a phrase, not to fill a button. The course code is the anchor of every screen and is set in the same monospace face a DE student's own IDE and lab reports already use — not a "technical" costume borrowed for effect, but the native display voice of this world.

The system is deliberately restrained: one saturated color (the highlighter), one fixed structural line (the red margin rule, present even on "Loading…"), and otherwise flat paper, hairline rules, and dark ink. Depth is conveyed by paper-and-ink metaphors — a highlighter mark, a physical index-tab reveal — never by card shadows or colored left borders standing in for hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-white ground, graphite ink, hairline rule-blue dividers — no gray cards
One highlighter accent, used as an underline/mark, never as a filled surface
A fixed red margin rule down the left edge, present on every screen
Course codes and headings in JetBrains Mono; body copy in system sans
Tabs behave as physical index dividers, not a flat connected bar

rules.name: The Margin Rule
rules.body: A 1.5px fixed red (#c0392b) vertical line sits at 28px from the left edge on every screen, including loading states. It is the one persistent structural device and the only fixed-position color line in the system.

rules.name: The Mark, Never a Button Rule
rules.body: The highlighter accent only ever appears as a mark behind fixed-dark-ink text or as `::selection`/active-tab fill. It is never a solid filled button background at full-box scale; that treatment shipped once during the build and was corrected in finish review.

rules.name: The Course Code Rule
rules.body: The course code is always set in mono, bold, full ink color, and given a fixed minimum width in list rows so codes align into a column.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Course rows, empty states, error messages, and cards carry no box-shadow. Structure comes from hairline rules and the fixed margin rule, never from drop shadows.

dos: Do use the highlighter mark (--accent-mark) only as a mark behind fixed dark-ink text or as the selected-tab fill — never as a full-box button background.
Do set every course code, heading, and label in JetBrains Mono; keep body copy on the system sans stack.
Do use hairline (--rule) or dashed (--rule-strong) horizontal rules for structure and hierarchy, not card shadows or colored borders.
Do keep the fixed red margin rule present and un-obstructed on every screen, including loading and error states.
Do use --accent (not --accent-mark) for any text or line color that sits directly on paper — it is the contrast-safe pairing.
donts: Don't render the primary action as a solid filled button or a flat, connected tab bar — both were shipped once during the build and corrected in finish review as contract violations, not styles to repeat.

Don't introduce card-style box-shadows on content surfaces (rows, panels, cards); the tab's shallow shadow is a named exception tied to its physical-index-divider metaphor, not a general elevation token.
Don't stand in Unicode arrows or emoji for icons; icons are authored SVG at a single consistent stroke weight (see src/components/icons.tsx).
Don't apply the ruled-paper background texture to dense content screens — it's reserved for the single sparse auth/onboarding card.
